description: The gate's ETA and lifecycle events (GX-25, D-070): which quantile of the ledger it reads, how much history, the fallback, and the one-key switch for gate.started and the verdict-time gate.slow / slo evaluate.

gate-eta.eta_history_events.description: Newest engine.step.measured events per stage that the ETA reads from the ledger.

gate-eta.eta_quantile.description: Quantile of the stage durations (engine.step.measured, slo.step_stats) that the gate's ETA uses per stage (0.5 is p50). gate.started.expected_wall_s is the critical path over these.

gate-eta.fallback_stage_s.description: Expected seconds of a stage with no sample in the ledger or the local reports (a fresh container), so the ETA is never 'no history'.

gate-eta.report_last_gates.description: Newest gates the timing report compares expected_wall_s with the real wall time over (the ETA error).

gate-eta.report_quantiles.description: Nearest-rank quantiles the gate timing report prints per stage, as fractions (0.9 is p90).

gate-eta.started_enabled.description: One-key rollback: true publishes gate.started at gate begin and, on each tier-1 verdict, calls forge_events.gate_slow and slo evaluate; false does neither and the verdict path is unchanged.
